integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library exact polynomial and survivor-enumeration verifier included; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Proven complete optimum only through seven species; for larger budgets only a reversal between two explicit allocations. No conclusions for correlated extinction, unequal survival, overlapping guilds, or actual ecosystems.
scientific_scope: Exactly three disjoint nonempty guilds, each function requiring two independently surviving species; at least two functions must persist; a common species survival probability strictly between zero and one.
title: A sharp seven-species transition in quorum-based functional resilience
